title: BIGGER! The Dev Log
tagline: How a solo student built a falling-sand film-set game in four days, with Claude Code and Unreal Engine 5.9.
author: Duncan Rose
intro:
BIGGER! is my solo entry to the Epic AI MegaJam 2026 (theme: Director's Cut). You're the special effects supervisor on a film shoot: rig the set, yell ACTION, and the director only ever wants one thing. Under every set runs a 3D falling-sand simulation, and your best takes are re-simulated into the Director's Cut.

One post a day while I build it, then the full story.
footer: BIGGER! is a solo entry to the Epic AI MegaJam 2026, made in Unreal Engine 5.9. Written by me; the facts are checked against my raw dev log.
